logic-fab.label: Logic fab
logic-fab.unit: wafer starts / month by node (300 mm equivalent)
logic-fab.quantifies: Monthly wafer starts by process node. Company disclosures rarely give a wafer-starts figure directly; watched sources may only confirm groundbreaking, equipment move-in or ramp milestones.
logic-fab.conversion: Compute equivalent = wafer starts/month x 12 x gross die per 300 mm wafer for the Nvidia H100-class reference die (grossDiePerWafer: floor of the standard Murphy-style approximation using the die area and wafer diameter). This is a ceiling assuming perfect yield and full allocation to one accelerator design; real product mix, yields and allocation are undisclosed and are not this figure.

packaging.label: Advanced packaging (CoWoS-class)
packaging.quantifies: Monthly CoWoS-class advanced-packaging wafer starts. Packagers rarely disclose a wafers-per-month figure directly; watched sources may only confirm groundbreaking, tool install or qualification milestones.
packaging.conversion: Compute equivalent = wafer starts/month x 12 x accelerators per CoWoS wafer (Epoch AI, latest overlapping quarter) for an accelerators/year figure, then x H100e per accelerator (same Epoch quarter) for an H100e/year figure. Illustrative scale using Epoch's Nvidia-mix ratios, not a company disclosure or a forecast for this specific site.

hbm-packaging.label: HBM packaging (stacking and test)
hbm-packaging.quantifies: Monthly qualified HBM stack output by generation.
hbm-packaging.conversion: No compute conversion: stack height, die size and yields per HBM generation are undisclosed, so stacks/month cannot be translated into accelerator or H100e counts here. Epoch AI separately estimates the value of HBM supply consumed by AI accelerators (epoch-hbm-supply-quarterly).

memory-fab.label: Memory fab
memory-fab.unit: wafer starts / month by node (300 mm equivalent)
memory-fab.quantifies: Monthly wafer starts for DRAM or NAND die production.
memory-fab.conversion: No compute conversion: DRAM/NAND die size, stack configuration and yields are undisclosed, so wafer starts cannot be translated into accelerator or H100e counts here. Epoch AI separately estimates the value of HBM supply consumed by AI accelerators (epoch-hbm-supply-quarterly).
